title: kubelet dies on the worker hosting Slinky's controller
teaches: Kubernetes and Slurm disagree: K8s declares the node lost and evicts after 5 minutes while slurmd keeps running jobs. Stateful pods can't be replaced until the old ones are confirmed gone.
